task: Add the canonical workforce profile dropdown and logout control to the authenticated admin shell without changing customer authentication, tenant selection or AAL2 policy.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This transaction adds a privileged-session termination control to the shared admin shell. It must preserve server-owned role context, use Supabase as the session authority, fail closed on sign-out failure, and avoid changing customer auth or the parked AAL2 policy.

acceptanceCriteria: Every authenticated admin shell exposes a profile dropdown containing the current workforce email/identity label, the server-resolved platform or merchant role label, and a logout action.
Logout delegates to the existing Supabase browser auth client and redirects to the dedicated workforce login only after Supabase confirms sign-out success.
A sign-out error leaves the current admin session in place and surfaces an actionable error instead of pretending logout succeeded.
Platform and merchant role labels are derived from the existing server-owned platform/store role authorities and are not read from client-editable metadata.
Customer logout/authentication surfaces, tenant-selection authority, middleware and the parked AAL2 enforcement PR remain unchanged.
The profile control remains usable in both the desktop sidebar and the existing mobile admin shell without creating a second navigation controller.
invariants: Supabase Auth remains the sole session/authentication authority; the profile component may request sign-out but may not create or mutate identity truth.
Admin role labels are computed by the server layout from getPlatformRole/getActiveStoreRoles and passed as display data only.
The admin profile menu is a presentation capability inside the canonical admin shell, not a parallel shell or authorization layer.
Logout success returns to /api/auth/workforce-login?next=%2Fadmin; it never routes the workforce user through the customer account login.
No AAL2, MFA enrollment, tenant selection, permission evaluation or middleware behavior changes in this release unit.

failureModes: The menu reuses the storefront/customer logout control and sends staff to the public storefront, collapsing the dedicated workforce entry contract.
The UI displays a role sourced from user metadata or another client-controlled value rather than the current platform/store role authority.
The browser navigates away even when signOut fails, leaving an active privileged session behind while presenting a false logged-out state.
Mobile styling hides or overlaps the profile/logout control because desktop sidebar geometry is merely shrunk.
edgeCases: A platform owner with no active tenant still sees a valid platform role label and can log out.
A merchant user with multiple active store roles receives a deterministic joined display label without changing permission authority.
A user with no displayable email receives a neutral workforce-account label rather than client-derived profile metadata.
Repeated logout clicks are disabled while a sign-out request is in flight.

alternatives.summary: Reuse src/components/auth/logout-button.tsx inside the admin shell.
alternatives.reason: That component returns to the public storefront and is customer-surface behavior; using it would blur the dedicated workforce login/logout contract.

alternatives.summary: Add one admin-shell profile component that consumes server-resolved identity display data and uses the existing Supabase browser client only for sign-out.
alternatives.reason: This keeps presentation in DOMAIN-ADMIN, session mutation in the canonical Supabase auth authority, and the workforce/customer entrypoints separate.

specialistReviews.finding: The profile dropdown belongs in the existing admin shell and may consume identity/role display context, but it must not become a new auth or navigation authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Render one AdminProfileMenu from src/app/admin/layout.tsx and keep all authorization decisions in existing server auth helpers.

specialistReviews.finding: A logout UI that redirects before confirming sign-out can create a false logged-out state while the privileged session remains active.
specialistReviews.resolution: Guard navigation on a successful Supabase auth.signOut result; on error, stay in place and show an alert.

challenge.finding: Redirecting anyway would conceal a still-active admin session.
challenge.resolution: Do not navigate; clear busy state and render an error alert.

challenge.scenario: The authenticated actor is a platform owner without a selected storefront.
challenge.finding: The profile menu must not depend on tenant/storefront resolution beyond the layout's already-valid platform role.
challenge.resolution: Use the existing platform role label and current auth user email; no tenant lookup is introduced by the menu.

challenge.scenario: The admin shell is rendered on mobile.
challenge.finding: A desktop-only floating profile widget could collide with the canonical mobile navigation.
challenge.resolution: Keep the profile control in normal sidebar flow with bounded responsive CSS rather than fixed/absolute positioning.

proofPlan: Add deterministic regression proof that the canonical roadmap requirement is implemented in the existing admin shell and that role display data comes from server-owned role resolution.

Prove the workforce logout component uses Supabase auth.signOut, blocks duplicate clicks, redirects only after success, exposes an error on failure, and never routes to the customer storefront/account entry.
Run full Quality Tests, TypeScript validation and Production Build.
Run Incremental Known Failure Replay plus Edit-Time/Reference Sync/Implementation Sync through the existing Control Plane.
Require exact-head Completion Truth VERIFIED and lifecycle closure before declaring this block complete.

requirements.requirement: The canonical admin shell exposes a workforce profile dropdown with server-resolved identity/role display context and a fail-closed Supabase-backed logout that returns to the dedicated workforce login.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Customer logout/authentication components and storefront login routing must remain unchanged.
A failed Supabase sign-out must not navigate away or present a successful logged-out state.
The profile menu must not derive privileged role truth from client-editable metadata.

notes: Independent MR1 release unit started from main e7a9c16 after PR #867 merged. PR #858 AAL2 enforcement remains parked and read-only. This block implements only the canonical profile dropdown/logout scope. Plan scope reconciled to the Control Plane planned-projection classification: the implementation remains DOMAIN-ADMIN/admin-operations authority while its dependency/test surface activates auth-access, customer-account and storefront guard coverage.
